narr: A band of thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours in northwest into central Alabama, which lifted slowly northeast during the early evening hours. Very heavy downpours resulted in flash flooding in parts of northwest Alabama, including the Florence area. Rainfall amounts reached 3-5 inches in a few isolated locations. A gust front produced strong and gusty winds in parts of north central Alabama in Morgan and Madison Counties, knocking a few trees down in Harvest. A few storms became severe within this outflow producing damaging microbursts as well.
ev: Six to 12 inches of water covering Darby Drive in front of the Foodland north of the intersection with Hwy 72 in Florence. Video relayed via social media.
Vehicles submerged/stalled on Florence Blvd at Patton Street intersection. Several vehicles towed from this location.
Gresham Road between Chisholm and Helton Drive is underwater. Estimated 6-12 inches of water covering road. Road being barricaded now and is a notorious low spot that floods in heavy rainfall events.
